title: Design System: ENOEDA Dojo — Tinta y sello

title.purpose: Page titles in the header and sheet titles — the largest text in the app, always semibold.

brand.purpose: The 'Enoeda Dojo' wordmark beside the emblem in the shell.

body.purpose: All UI text, list rows, form labels — 0.9375rem (15px) at the app's 16px root, scoped away from marketing via html:not(:has([data-marketing-page])). Money and counts additionally set in tabular-nums.

meta.purpose: Timestamps, level names, notes, badges; sidebar group labels add uppercase + 0.08em tracking.

shadows.name: sticky-action-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft upward cue under sticky bottom action bars so content scrolls visibly beneath them.

shadows.name: floating-panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-lg — side sheets and popovers only.

motion.name: seal-stamp
motion.value: 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both — keyframes attendance-seal-stamp: from rotate(-8deg) scale(1.25) to rotate(-8deg) scale(1)
motion.purpose: The only authored motion: one-shot stamp when attendance is saved. Skipped entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sumi ink fill, paper-bright text — the main action (e.g. 'Guardar asistencia').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Paper fill with hairline border — the workhorse secondary action ('Marcar todos presentes').
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: 10% carmine tint with carmine text — errors and destructive actions, never solid fills.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 40%, transparent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Badge
components.description: Near-pill mist chip for quiet source labels like 'Por clase'.
components.css: .ds-badge-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.6); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Outline Badge
components.description: Hairline-bordered chip for read-only history rows.
components.css: .ds-badge-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.6); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.description: The attendance sheet's defining pattern: ruled ledger lines with a hairline-bordered belt swatch, a bordered text marker pill for absence — never a card stack.

components.name: Attendance Seal
components.description: Vermilion hanko-style stamp: ring + inner rounded square + bold check, rotated −8°; the label renders beside it in ink, never inside the ring.

components.name: Ledger Seal
components.description: 24px seal for ledger rows with its own small-size geometry: one ring (r 10.5, stroke 2) and a bold check (stroke 2.25), rotated −8°, no inner square (it falls below a pixel at 24px). Use the full Attendance Seal from 44px up.

narrative.northStar: Tinta y sello — the app records the dojo's day like an ink ledger that gets sealed.
narrative.overview:
The authenticated app is a working ledger. Sumi blue-black ink owns the shell — the sidebar rail, the header text, the primary buttons — and cool paper carries the work area. Everything that needs doing is plain ink; everything that is done carries the red seal. The vermilion stamp is the single emotional gesture in an otherwise quiet, ruled, workmanlike system: closing work is the ritual, and the interface celebrates nothing else. It refuses the grey SaaS card grid with a decorative accent — structure comes from hairline rules, not from boxes and tints.

Density is compact and ledger-like (2rem controls, 1px rules, tabular numerals for money and counts), built for a teacher on a phone at the mat and an admin on desktop. Type is a single workhorse sans (Geist) doing all the work through weight and size — no serif, no display face. There is exactly one theme: a single light theme, with the class-based dark: variant intentionally kept inert.
keyCharacteristics: Shell by width: ink top bar with a sheet rail below md (768px), a 48px icon rail between md and lg (starts collapsed, expandable), the expanded rail from lg (the user's toggle owns it).
Ink shell, paper ground, white work panels — three flat planes separated by 1px hairlines.
Vermilion seal red (--seal) reserved exclusively for done/active state; never decoration.
Lists read as ruled ledger lines (1px rule in every state), never card stacks.
Tabular numerals for money and counts; compact 2rem control height.
Belt colors from discipline_levels.color are the only other chroma, always as a hairline-bordered swatch.
Type root is split by surface: the app runs 16px; marketing keeps 18px via html:has([data-marketing-page]).
One authored motion: a reduced-motion-aware one-shot seal stamp (220ms expo-out).
Browser surfaces are themed: selection, caret, accent color, scrollbar all speak ink.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is reserved exclusively for done/active state. Never decoration, never a second accent, never small text (its contrast, 4.15–4.34:1, forbids it). On the ink shell it appears only as the active nav icon.

rules.name: The One Chroma Rule
rules.body: Real belt colors from discipline_levels.color are the only other chroma in the system, and they always render as a small hairline-bordered swatch (so a white belt stays visible on paper). No arbitrary color values anywhere else.

rules.name: The Print-Grey Rule
rules.body: Retired or inactive entities print grey — muted ink, no color — like struck entries in a ledger.

rules.name: The No-Color-Only Rule
rules.body: Absence and state are never color alone: an absent row gets a bordered text marker pill ("Ausente"), not just a tint.

rules.name: The Workhorse Rule
rules.body: Geist is the only family; heavy title weights carry the hierarchy. No serif, no display face — user-approved, 2026-10-16.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Money and counts are always tabular numerals, so columns of figures align like a ruled ledger.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: 1px rules structure the page. Lists read as ruled ledger lines — every row carries its bottom rule in every state; they never become a stack of bordered cards.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, single-direction lift cues for floating surfaces only. No hard offset shadows, ever.

dos: Do reserve seal vermilion for done/active state only: active nav icon, sealed attendance, the post-save stamp. Its rarity is the point.
Do structure lists with 1px hairlines in every row state — ledger lines, not card stacks.
Do set all money and counts in tabular numerals.
Do render belt colors from discipline_levels.color as hairline-bordered swatches, with the level name available to screen readers.
Do print retired/inactive entities in muted ink with outline badges.
Do pair every state color with a text or geometric marker (absent tint + "Ausente" pill).
Do keep the single light theme; leave the dark: variant inert rather than deleting it, so leftover utilities stay harmless.
Do keep controls compact (2rem default) and the seal stamp the only authored motion.
donts: Don't use the seal vermilion as decoration, for hover states, or for text below ~14px (contrast 4.15–4.34:1 forbids it).
Don't introduce a second accent or arbitrary colors — belt colors are the only other chroma.
Don't stack bordered cards where a ruled list will do; don't add tints to differentiate list states beyond the absent row's 60% mist.
Don't add a dark theme or honor prefers-color-scheme in the authenticated app.
Don't use hard offset shadows or add new authored animations.
Don't put text inside the seal ring; the label renders beside it.
Don't let the app-only --text-sm override (0.9375rem) leak into the marketing root — marketing keeps its own 18px root and its own text-sm.
